**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The renewal package in §§ 8.2–8.3 already sits at or above our preferred position:

- **Renewal term:** successive twelve-month periods — no multi-year auto-renewal (walk-away risk absent).
- **Opt-out window:** thirty days' written notice by Customer, at the tight end of our preferred ≤30 days.
- **Reminder:** Vendor must remind us at least sixty days before renewal, and a missed reminder extends our opt-out to thirty days after receipt — slightly better than our ask.
- **Uplift cap:** lesser of US CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice of any increase (a Vendor-side obligation benefiting us) and no increase on prepaid periods.

I also confirmed there is no competing renewal or price-escalation language anywhere else in the document, and § 2.2 allows an Order Form to override only for that Order Form and only where it expressly identifies the conflicting provision — so renewal or uplift terms cannot be pushed into an Order Form silently. Our § 9.4 convenience-termination right on thirty days' notice provides a further exit.
